subject: Post-call: SOC 2 & compliance checklist for Redwood inference (ZenHealth evaluation)
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Pamela Ortiz <pamela.ortiz@zenhealth.com>, James Li <james.li@zenhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: SOC 2 & compliance checklist for Redwood inference (ZenHealth evaluation)

Hi Pamela / James —

Thanks again for taking the call today. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps so your security and procurement teams have what they need for evaluation. Please flag anything I missed.

Summary of key pain points you shared:
- Strict data retention and e-discovery rules for PHI-derived metadata (30–365 day retention windows depending on dataset).
- Requirement for system-level audit logs with exportable retention and immutable storage for 1+ years.
- Need for a SOC 2 Type II report, pen test evidence, and an exportable security mapping for our controls to your control set.
- Contract/DPA redlines around data processing, subprocessor list, and breach notification timelines.
- Interest in an isolated/private deployment (VPC/on-prem) for regulated workloads.

What Redwood committed to share (attachments included):
1) Redwood_SOC2_Type2_2026.pdf — full SOC 2 Type II report and auditor opinion (attached).
2) pen_test_summary_2026.pdf — executive summary of most recent third‑party penetration test (attached).
3) DPA_Redwood_v1.2.docx — draft DPA with comments.
4) Drive folder with mapping and evidence: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/zenhealth-evidence (linked below).

Immediate next steps / mutual action plan:
- Rishi: Share SOC 2, pen test summary, and draft DPA (done — attached).
- Marissa: Schedule a 60-minute security deep-dive with your InfoSec/infra team to walk the SOC mapping and log retention options — propose Wed 5/26 or Thu 5/27.
- Procurement (ZenHealth): Share standard SOW/contract redlines by 6/1 so we can align legal + pricing.
- James / Pamela: Confirm whether BYOK / customer-managed KMS is required for production or only for pilot (ask answered below).

Target timeline:
- Security deep-dive: week of 5/24–5/28
- Procurement review & redlines: by 6/1
- Pilot kickoff (if approvals met): target early July

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_Type2_2026.pdf, pen_test_summary_2026.pdf, DPA_Redwood_v1.2.docx

If helpful, I can include our solution architect and the runtime infra lead on the deep-dive to walk deployment options (hosted vs. private).

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com | (650) 555-0142

From: James Li <james.li@zenhealth.com>

Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 15:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: SOC 2 & compliance checklist for Redwood inference (ZenHealth evaluation)

Thanks Rishi — very helpful summary. A few clarifying questions from InfoSec + procurement before we lock the deep-dive: 

1) Retention: Can you confirm whether audit log retention is configurable per-tenant and whether logs can be exported to our S3 bucket with object-lock for immutability?
2) KMS / BYOK: For the private/VPC deployment, do you support customer-managed keys? If not, what are the planned timelines and alternatives (HSM/KMS integrations)?
3) Scope of SOC 2: Does the attached SOC 2 cover both hosted and dedicated offerings, or only the hosted control plane? We need clarity on whether Dedicated/Private deployments have equivalent attestations or compensating controls.
4) Pen test details: The summary is good — can you provide the full report (redacted as needed) or a vulnerability tracker so we can assess remediation timelines?
5) DPA: Procurement will propose a couple of standard redlines (limitation of liability, subcontractor flowdowns, and incident notification windows). Can Marissa own the legal sync?

If you can answer those points and drop a proposed time for the deep-dive (we prefer Wed 5/26 10:00–11:00 PT), procurement will do a quick internal touchpoint and send initial contract comments by 6/1.

Thanks,
James
Director, IT Security — ZenHealth
james.li@zenhealth.com

> 
> Thanks again for taking the call today. Quick recap from our side...

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: James Li <james.li@zenhealth.com>, Pamela Ortiz <pamela.ortiz@zenhealth.com>

Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 16:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: SOC 2 & compliance checklist for Redwood inference (ZenHealth evaluation)

James — thanks for the quick questions. Answers below, and I included links/attachments for the deeper artifacts we discussed.

1) Audit log retention/export:
- Yes — audit/log retention is configurable at the customer level for both hosted and Dedicated modes.
- We support exporting audit logs to an S3-compatible endpoint (AWS S3, GCS via interop) and can enable object-lock retention on delivery if you control the destination bucket.

2) KMS / BYOK:
- For Redwood Private (VPC / on-prem), we support customer-managed keys (BYOK) via AWS KMS or an HSM-backed gateway. For hosted API, we offer envelope encryption and integrations with major KMS providers; pure BYOK for hosted is available as an enterprise option.

3) SOC 2 scope:
- The attached Redwood_SOC2_Type2_2026.pdf covers our hosted control plane and the core data handling controls. For Dedicated/Private deployments, we provide a SOC mapping and compensating controls document (see drive link). Our SOC attestation covers the SaaS control plane; Dedicated environments are included where Redwood manages the stack under the same control framework — we'll walk specifics in the deep-dive.

4) Pen test details:
- We can provide the full penetration test report under an NDA / mutual non-disclosure redaction process. The attached pen_test_summary_2026.pdf includes findings and remediations; I'll have our security lead create a vulnerability tracker export for your team to review.

5) DPA & procurement coordination:
- Marissa will own the legal sync and is cc'd. Marissa — can your legal lead take procurement@zenhealth.com's redlines and schedule a quick contract review the week of 5/31?

Next steps (updated):
- Marissa: Schedule security deep-dive for Wed 5/26 10:00–11:00 PT (proposed) — include infra/security and our runtime/solutions leads.
- Rishi: Submit full vulnerability tracker under NDA (I can route to your security email for secure transfer).
- ZenHealth procurement: Share contract redlines by 6/1.

Artifacts / links attached: Redwood_SOC2_Type2_2026.pdf; pen_test_summary_2026.pdf; DPA_Redwood_v1.2.docx
Drive mapping: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/zenhealth-evidence
HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.company/record/ZH-2027-145

If that all looks good I’ll lock the deep-dive and send an invite.

Best,
Rishi
